brief.headline: Push for 8–12% price cut and 30-day payment — they keep 8.5% profit versus 4.8% peer average, so there's room

priceAsk.summary: Ask for 8–12% off current prices on rigid plastic packaging
priceAsk.target: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc for the 28 mm cap (currently market-fair at ₹0.85–0.95/pc)
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume. They keep 8.5% profit versus 4.8% for similar firms — that 3.7-point gap is room in their price. Their operating profit sits at 14.5%, so a cut won't hurt them.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹2.15 L of cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Triveni is safe: they carry zero debt (0.00x), keep 8.5% of every ₹100 as profit (nearly double the 4.8% peer number), and cover interest 75.84 times over. But their cash is stuck for 124 days (versus 114 for peers) and they burned ₹6.59 Cr in free cash last year — so cash is tight for them despite the healthy books. We're tiny at 0.15% of their ₹179.69 Cr revenue, which limits our pull on our own. The play: bundle volume, shorten payment to help their cash, and name Manjushree or Mold-Tek as a credible second source to create pressure.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, does pharma bottles and caps, health score B (65/100) — the top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹1010.97 Cr, pharma pails and containers, health score B (73/100) — a robust alternate for bottles and closures

risks: We're only 0.15% of their business (₹26.17 L spend versus ₹179.69 Cr revenue) — alone we have little leverage; bundle more SKUs or threaten to move volume to Manjushree
They show EPF payment delays as a risk flag — watch for any supply hiccups and keep an alternate warm

brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to lock in a three-year deal at ₹0.70–0.75 per cap and move to 30-day payment — that gives you cash faster and us a fair price in line with the market at volume.
